CTRL-RT-4 uniform-error: generate LWE instance with e=uniform(Z_q^m). Expected correct-candidate mean score ≈ 0. Record mean and compare against 3σ of expectation.

For the 50 variance runs: use the SAME instance seed (20260803001) and SAME fpylll seed (20260803005). VARY ONLY the g6k Siever seed. Seeds must be deterministic and recorded: use range(50) or similar, recorded in receipt.
Each sieve run produces N=17919 vectors (match batch-1 exactly). If a run produces a different count, record the count and use it — do not discard the run.
Compute T_N = sum_{i=1}^{N} cos(2π·t_i(s)/q) for the CORRECT CANDIDATE only. t_i(s) is from phases_t[0] in each run's score output. T_N is a SCALAR per run.

Record all 50 T_N values in variance_results.json. Also record the single-score Var[s_i] = Var[cos(2π·t_i/q)] computed from batch-1 raw_scores.json phases_t[0]. Compute independence-predicted N·Var[s_i]. Compare empirical Var[T_N] against N·Var[s_i].
